snapshot_policy: Only the two required crates' Cargo.toml, src trees, required compile-time convention assets, plus upstream licence, notice, provenance, and readme files are copied byte-for-byte under upstream/.
packaging_workspace: Cargo.toml is Studio-owned packaging metadata outside upstream/; it supplies the unchanged crates' inherited workspace fields.
release_gate: Replace this transient snapshot with an exact published package or remotely fetchable git revision before LOCK-RELEASE.
